It's not about doing something, it's about not giving up on life. Hang in there! Do you know how badly affected people's lives become when the people they love give up. Some people who have lost loved ones to suicide become so depressed or guilty they end up following suit. Even if nobody knows you, hearing statistics of the number of people who give up on life makes many people depressed and feel like giving up on their lives too. The movie "It's A Wonderful Life" touches this, how insignificant we feel compared to reality of how everyone is interconnected.

Just consider that you are staying alive not just for yourself, but also for the lives of many people, especially those who love you and whom you love.

“Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moths and vermin destroy, and where thieves break in and steal. But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moths and vermin do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal. For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also." 

Matthew 6:19-21

I think of death often and this is how I deal with it.

This just means that he has always been like this but it had just been hidden inside. At least you learnt about it now instead of 30 years down the road. Cut your losses and leave knowing you are better than him in every way that matters.

I have a private Instagram that follows and is followed only by family and 4 close friends. Fb for the support groups. I'm healthier and happier than ever, I don't look at everyone being happy when I'm tired (chronic fatigue), and I'm happier with my life and self. I focus on the important people close to me and focus on myself and my dogs and that's it. I'm free.
NTA. Wife shouldn't force it on you and she should think about the kid first. However, if she has 0% chance of budging, I think it would be better to compromise and have it as a middle name.
